protocol.development_history: Actors 01-06 and fusion_v2 results have been observed; all are excluded here. This Git commit records the plan before collecting Actors 07-24. It is not an external preregistration.
protocol.question: Does preserving unsupported-label mass improve fusion of frozen speech and face classifiers with partially overlapping label support?
protocol.preprocessing: Official full audiovisual speech files 01-01; calm excluded without relabelling; midpoint video frame, production one-face cropper, mono 16 kHz audio; same frozen experts and preprocessing as fusion_v2.
protocol.failure_policy: Retain all 52 attempted records per actor, including failures. Compare all methods on exactly the same successful pairs. Report overall and actor/class coverage; do not replace failures. Stop if any split has no successful samples or a required actor is absent.
protocol.fit_objective: Temperature minimizes fitting NLL; audio temperature only on supported truth labels. Beta(1,1) predicted-class reliability uses all fitting labels, with unsupported audio truths counted as incorrect. Conditional reliability is a separate ablation.
protocol.selection: Each tunable method independently maximizes validation seven-class macro F1. First grid entry wins a tie. Primary adaptive hierarchy has gamma=0; entropy selection is secondary only.
protocol.secondary_comparisons: Adaptive hierarchy versus independently selected adaptive zero-padding, static hierarchy and calibrated face. Conditional reliability, no calibration and entropy are ablations. Secondary comparisons are descriptive, without confirmatory significance claims.

uncertainty.primary_interval: Paired actor-cluster percentile 95% interval for macro F1 difference
uncertainty.primary_test: Exact two-sided paired actor-block permutation, enumerate all 2^8 method swaps, statistic absolute macro F1 difference; exchangeability assumption and limited actor population explicitly noted

protocol.stress: Missing audio, missing face, and 50% uniform mixing of calibrated audio scores. Score-level stress only; no claim of physical noise robustness.
protocol.selection_isolation: fit command reads development records only and saves a hashed fitted.json artifact. Test inference starts only after fit succeeds. evaluate accepts that fitted artifact and never refits or selects on test outcomes.
protocol.stop_rule: Report every prespecified method and all negative findings after one complete held-out evaluation. Any method or split change after examining test results requires new untouched evaluation data.
protocol.scope: Single-dataset frozen-model empirical study, not clinical validation or proof of algorithmic novelty. Second dataset, second model pair, physical corruption and compute benchmarks remain separate future milestones. Published model pretraining overlap cannot be comprehensively excluded.

primary_uncertainty.caveat: Limited actor population; block exchangeability is assumed. Not clinical or cross-dataset evidence.
